tasks.title: RTL margin on a legacy config
tasks.statement: The repository holds a `.param` from firmware before 4.7: `RTL_ALT = {x}`. In `fleet.yaml` the site has `obstacle_m: {h}`. By how many meters is the return altitude above the obstacles (a negative number means below)?
tasks.solution: Before ArduPilot 4.7 the parameter was called `RTL_ALT` and was in centimeters; in 4.7 it is `RTL_ALT_M`, in meters. Margin = RTL_ALT/100 − obstacle_m. A rule that compares `RTL_ALT` with meters without dividing by 100 lets any config through (1500 "m" is higher than any obstacle).
